create_h1_env: create an H1Env instance with an xml path, config, and optional config overrides
get_robot_gravity: get the gravity vector in the world frame from mjx simulation data
get_robot_velocity: get the linear and angular velocity of the robot in world and local frames
get_sensor_readings: get accelerometer and gyroscope readings from the robot's local frame
access_h1_model: access the mj_model, mjx_model, xml_path, and action_size properties of an H1Env
